facts.fact: Minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni told parliament that a second phase of the national broadband plan (PNHD) has been launched to serve 1,800 rural zones by 2026.
facts.system: Plan national du haut et du très haut débit (PNHD)

facts.fact: The minister reported that PNHD phase one covered over 10,640 rural zones between 2018 and 2024, about 99 per cent of its target.
facts.system: Plan national du haut et du très haut débit (PNHD)

facts.fact: The minister said PNHD phase two is carried out with the support of the Universal Telecommunications Service Fund.
facts.system: Plan national du haut et du très haut débit (PNHD)
